source: Register spilling is one common reason values reach local memory. ZXNAME0000XZ may also place some large or dynamically indexed thread-local objects there. These accesses travel through the device-memory and cache path, so they are far more expensive than register access and can add substantial memory traffic.[2]
zh: 寄存器溢出是值到达本地内存的常见原因之一。 ZXNAME0000XZ 还可以在那里放置一些大型或动态索引的线程本地对象。这些访问通过设备内存和缓存路径，因此它们比寄存器访问昂贵得多，并且会增加大量内存流量。 [2]
